text:
sam: spotting p95 latency spike on prod-east-3, started ~2298765400. multiple kernel v2.3.1 hosts showing long tails on kernel selection. anyone on call?
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: latency-spike-prod-east-3 triggered at 2298765400. p95=780ms (baseline ~220ms). Severity P2. Runbook: /runbooks/latency-spike.
tia: on it — starting a 30s sampling profiler on a representative host.
sam: uploaded a flame/profile: https://redwood.k8s/internal/profiles/2298765432 (30s)
derek: quick look: kernel_handoff queue shows ~30% of requests stuck ~15-30ms extra before kernel selection. precedes a KV cache miss storm.
maria: could be autoswitch churn between kernels. suggestion: flip feature flag kvcache_autoswitch=false for prod-east-3 while we triage?
tia: agree. also reduce batch_window_ms from 12->6 temporarily; that will reduce cross-request kernel switching.
sam: toggling flag for prod-east-3 now -> `curl -XPOST https://ops.internal/flags -d '{"kvcache_autoswitch":false,"scope":"prod-east-3"}'`
ops-bot: FLAG_UPDATE: kvcache_autoswitch=false set in prod-east-3 by sam at 2298765485
leo: I'll add a temp routing shim: divert low-latency traffic to model-lite fallback for hosts with high kernel churn to limit user impact.
tia: please also add tenant throttle for heavy short-seq workloads (tenant=studio). those were the biggest contributors to the miss storm.
leo: routing change applied: exclude host-group hg-13 from default pool -> `route:prod-east-3 exclude hg-13`
ops-bot: ROUTE_UPDATE: prod-east-3 updated by leo at 2298765530
incidents-bot: Metric check: p95 dropped to 260ms after mitigation actions. Continue monitoring for 10m.
sam: :thumbsup: good lift. keep the kvcache_autoswitch=false and batch_window=6 for 30m, then we can roll back if stable. also please open a perf regression ticket — kernel selector fallback frequency jumped post-2.3.1 release.
derek: filed ticket ENG-RUNTIME-4567: "kernel-selector fallback surge after 2.3.1 — perf regression". attached flame and sampling profile. https://tracker.internal/ENG-RUNTIME-4567
tia: notes for the ticket: no CPU saturation observed. root cause looks like selector lock contention + bursty KV miss pattern. plan: add finer-grained selector instrumentation and a microbench to reproduce.
maria: I'll schedule a canary test to roll a shard back to v2.3.0 to confirm regression, then run microbench.
sam: thanks all. tagging oncall @derek for followups with SRE. closing the slack loop; will update the incident page and the ticket with next steps.
leo: quick follow-up — important to capture request-size distribution; studio tenant had a spike of short-seq requests during the period which amplified kernel churn. adding to the ticket.
sam: noted. if p95 holds for 30m we'll de-escalate.
